316_2_12.name: PIR Re-Detect Interval Time
316_2_12.description: In the normal mode, after the PIR motion detected, setting the re-detect time. 8 seconds per tick, default tick is 1 (8 seconds).Setting the suitable value to prevent received the trigger signal too frequently. Also can save the battery energy.
